ava: Quick morning check-in on atlas9b bring-up. Ran int6 and int4 quant across our standard GTN slices. Cost: fp16 $0.29/1k, int6 $0.11/1k, int4 $0.06/1k.

ria: any red flags on QA or legal slices?

ava: Biggest hit on multi-paragraph QA (precision@3 down 0.09 for int4 vs fp16). Summarization and short chat look fine. Latency p95 slightly better for int4. Repro: `eval/run.sh --model atlas9b --quants fp16,int6,int4 --slices multi-qa,summary,chat-short`

sam: Did you check hallucination delta and top1 confidence shift?

ava: hallucination_ppm fp16=10, int4=36 on multi-qa. mean top1 prob shifted -0.05. KV cache stats unchanged.

jia: Product ask: provide a blended deployment proposal with routing guardrails and a minimal scorecard.

ava: Proposed scorecard fields: slice_name, baseline_prec3,quant_prec3,delta_prec3,baseline_cost_per1k,quant_cost_per1k,halluc_ppm,latency_p95. Short csv snippet: 
`multi-qa,0.78,0.69,-0.09,0.29,0.06,36,420ms`

ria: Ops suggestion: hybrid routing rule: prefer int4 for slices not in {multi-qa,legal,financial} and use int6 as the default online quant. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% with autoscale checks. Fallback to fp16 on detected regressions.

sam: Also recommend automated counter for regressed examples (rolling window 10k, budget 40) and a confidence_shift threshold (-0.04) to pause canary.

ops-bot: ops-bot: canary-policy created id=6602, monitors=regression_counter,confidence_shift (link: https://k.rw/canary/6602)

jia: GTN guidance draft: default int6 for live routes; int4 allowed for background jobs, short summaries, and high-volume read-only endpoints. Require 10k adversarial sample pass and regression_budget verification before >30% rollout.

ava: Next steps I own: 1) run 10k adversarial eval tonight, 2) add scorecard csv to eng-ml drive, 3) open routing change PR for hybrid rule. I'll post results in this thread.

ria: thanks — if the 10k shows regressions above budget we keep int6 for online and use int4 for async only.

sam: small note for billing calc: blended 30% fp16 + 70% int4 = 0.3*0.29 + 0.7*0.06 = $0.127/1k. For 2M queries/month at 400 tokens/query that's ~ $101.6k/mo vs fp16-only ~$232k/mo.

ava: uploading CSV to drive now.
